title: Disappointing
text: Disappointing. I found these framed dried flowers to be disappointing. Both of these had broken pieces of dried flowers sitting in the bottom of the frame. They're visible and it looks messy. I also thought the colors were too bright. The flowers in the product pictures were a bit more subdue. The pink one is really bright pink in person. I was hoping for the lighter colors because they would look better with my decor. .

description: Add a fresh touch to your home with the Madison Park Avant Garden Dried Flower 2-piece Shadow Box Wall Decor Set. This shadowbox framed art features real sundried flowers that are dyed and placed under glass, for a unique and naturally feminine look. Each piece is then cast in a natural wood color MDF frame highlighting every branch and petal beautifully; while Sawtooth fixtures on the reverse make each piece easy to hang. Place this 2 piece shadowbox set together as a focus piece or hang separately to give any space the perfect soft floral and farmhouse update. Flowers may fade or discolor over time, due to the natural properties of real flowers.
